examples.text: Hauptsächlich deshalb habe ich das gemacht.
examples.en: That was the main reason I did that.

examples.text: Kinder lügen hauptsächlich, um keinen Ärger zu bekommen.
examples.en: The main reason kids tell lies is to avoid getting into trouble.

examples.text: Meinen Erfolg verdanke ich hauptsächlich deiner Hilfe.
examples.en: My success was mainly due to your help.
The Japanese live mainly on rice.
